requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and encryption of user data to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall implement controlled real-time data synchronization with flexible thresholds for critical updates to enhance efficiency while minimizing energy consumption.
The system shall provide automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support compliance and long-term analysis.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms and load balancing techniques to optimize resource utilization.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
